changelog:
Landing Page Conversion Audit — v1.0.0

- Initial release of the landing-page-conversion-audit skill.
- Provides an 8-factor, scored CRO audit (0–80 total) for any landing page input (URL, copy, screenshot, description).
- Outputs a prioritized fix list with quick wins and strategic recommendations, plus an executive summary.
- Evaluates: headline clarity, supporting copy, social proof, call-to-action, visual hierarchy, trust signals, mobile/speed signals, and offer clarity.
- Adapts to available information and flags scoring limitations when input is incomplete or ambiguous.
